reason: A document-processing plugin that translates text and whole files with configurable languages, styles, and terminology, using SiliconFlow-hosted DeepSeek models and optional in-place file write-back.

summaries.zh: 提供可配置语言、风格和术语表的文本及文件翻译，并支持保留格式和可选的原文件写回。
summaries.en: Translates text and files with configurable languages, writing styles, and glossaries while preserving formats and optionally writing results back in place.

capabilities: Translates text using DeepSeek models through SiliconFlow
Translates whole files while preserving documented formats
Can write translated content back to files when inPlace is enabled
Sends translation data to the SiliconFlow API
